name: Math Rock (7/8)
description: Asymmetric-meter loop with a mid-song 4/4 deception. Exercises the odd-meter drum engine.

defaults.concept: Angular math rock in 7/8 — clean finger-tapped guitars, interlocking parts, tight conversational pocket, one deceptive pivot to straight time.

slots.label: Bright Tapping Intro
slots.purpose: FEEL: Jittery, expectant, suspended. TRICK: Keep drum parts completely silent for the first 4 bars. Let clean, dry finger-tapped guitar lines carry the metric ambiguity before the raw MIDI rhythm triggers on bar 5.

slots.label: Interlocking Poly-Verse
slots.purpose: FEEL: Intricate, tight conversational pocket. PRODUCTION NOTE: The generated drum clip should rely entirely on crisp snare ghost notes and rapid rim-shots, purposefully accentuating the missing final eighth note of the measure.

slots.label: The Metric Deception
slots.purpose: FEEL: Floating and wide. TRICK: Sudden pivot to a straight 4/4 pulse. Strings should maintain their original 7-beat phrases overlapping the new bar boundaries to displace the downbeat accents seamlessly.

slots.label: Explosive Math Climax
slots.purpose: FEEL: Urgent and mathematically intense. PRODUCTION NOTE: The underlying drum layout drops tight hat patterns, switching completely to an open, continuous ride-cymbal wash to blow open the sonic energy.
